name: app-vehicular
description: Aplicación vehicular: backend NestJS y cliente móvil React/Capacitor

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file backend/.env up -d db redis
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose --env-file backend/.env --profile tools run --rm migrate
scripts.db:seed: docker compose --env-file backend/.env --profile tools run --rm migrate npx prisma db seed
